description:
Port upstream openai-responses.ts + openai-responses-shared.ts as a new umbrella app or module within octo_pi_ai_openai.

The OpenAI Responses API is a newer API shape (distinct from Chat Completions). Key differences from Completions:
- Uses `responses.create()` instead of `chat.completions.create()`
- Message format uses `input` array with items (not `messages`)
- Tools use `type: "function"` wrapper with different schema
- Response stream uses different chunk format (response.output_item.*, response.content_part.*)
- Supports prompt caching via `cache_retention` parameter
- Built-in tool call support for OpenAI-native tools

**Scope:**
- Request builder: convert Context messages + tools to Responses API format
- Decoder: ResponseStreamEvent → canonical OctoPi.AI.Event events
- Producer GenServer: SSE streaming via Req/Mint
- Provider behaviour implementation + Application wiring
- Cache retention support (short/long)
- Copilot dynamic headers support (shared with Completions)

**Upstream ref:** openai-responses.ts (264 lines), openai-responses-shared.ts (539 lines)
title: OpenAI Responses provider (octo_pi_ai_openai_responses)
